remarks: Beautiful Chautauqua Lakeview 3 bedroom with lots of updates and huge yard for cookouts and camp fires with wooded back yard. New 2025-26 sewer, well (well was recently installed a few years ago but electric and inside equipment all new), arch roof, siding, electric service, hot water tank, bathtub, carpet and paint. Home with tremendous views of the lake with boat launch and lake acsess minutes away. Living room with wood burning fireplace (not tested) with plenty of stacked firewood, formal dining room, florida room and laundry hookups in the kitchen with refrigerator, stove and dishwasher. Home does have dated kitchen and can use some finishing touches. Upstairs largest bedroom needs either radiators continued or electric baseboard heat. Basement has dirt floor and garage has settled on left side as seen in photos. Located on Rt 394 which is main road that circles the lake on south side. Owner is willing to make any additional updates based on offer.
